mapper.select: SELECT id,need_name,factory_id,cargo_id,cargo_total_weight,required_vehicle_type,status,CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_deleted FROM need WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id,need_name,factory_id,cargo_id,cargo_total_weight,required_vehicle_type,status,CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_deleted FROM need WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE need SET deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),status='CANCELLED' WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE need SET status='ASSIGNED' WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status='PENDING'
